---
title: "Johan Norberg at UNSW"
date: "2005-09-20"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

[Johan Norberg](http://www.johannorberg.net/ "Johan Norberg"), author of [In Defence of Global Capitalism](http://www.lfb.com/cart/affiliate.php?code=10488&stocknumber=EC8589 "In Defence of Global Capitalism"), will be giving a free lunch time forum at the Australian Graduate School of Management, University of New South Wales, on Wednesday 12 October between 1:00-1:45 pm.  The topic for the forum is Why Globalisation is the Cure for Terrorism.  RSVP by 10 October: rsvp at agsm.edu.au.

Norberg is profiled [here](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/common/story_page/0,5744,16626409%255E28737,00.html "here").
